tickets.title: Open New Client Account
tickets.text: Start intake for a new joint taxable account funded from excess cash reserve. Collect ownership and risk profile information before preparing paperwork.

subTasks.title: Gather account opening details
subTasks.text: Collect required registration type, ownership details, beneficiary or authorized-party information if applicable, tax identification documentation status, risk profile, and intended funding source using firm-approved intake materials.

subTasks.title: Prepare and review application package
subTasks.text: Complete the custodian or platform forms, advisory agreement updates, fee schedule, disclosure delivery record, and any transfer or funding paperwork. Check for missing signatures, inconsistent names, and incomplete suitability information.

subTasks.title: Coordinate signatures and submission
subTasks.text: Send the application package through the approved signature process, track completion, and submit to the custodian or operations platform after verifying all required fields are complete.

subTasks.title: Confirm account setup and funding readiness
subTasks.text: Verify that the account is established, document the account title and registration, confirm funding or transfer instructions are ready, and notify the advisor that the account is available for investment review.

tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2025-08-05 to start intake for a new joint taxable account funded from excess cash reserve, with ownership and risk profile information to be collected before paperwork is prepared.

tickets.title: Update beneficiary and transfer-on-death forms
tickets.text: Document current household intentions before updating beneficiary and transfer-on-death forms for Nora’s IRA, 401(k), and taxable account records, which still list pre-marriage beneficiaries or no contingent beneficiary.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2025-08-15 to document current household intentions before updating beneficiary and transfer-on-death forms, after a review found Nora’s IRA, 401(k), and taxable account records still list pre-marriage beneficiaries or no contingent beneficiary.

tickets.title: Obtain proof of marriage
tickets.text: Obtain and submit proof of marriage to the custodian for name and household registration updates. Nora had not uploaded the certificate through the secure portal.
tickets.evidence: Proof of marriage remains needed by 2025-08-01 because the custodian requires it for certain name and household registration updates, and Nora had not uploaded the certificate through the secure portal.

tickets.title: Refresh monthly cash flow worksheet
tickets.text: Refresh the monthly cash flow worksheet using combined pay and the six-month essential-expenses reserve target. Account for Caleb’s student loan payment and the townhouse mortgage in the household plan.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2025-08-20 to refresh the monthly cash flow worksheet using combined pay and the reserve target because Caleb’s student loan payment and the townhouse mortgage will now be considered in one household plan.

tickets.title: Coordinate employer benefit elections
tickets.text: Coordinate employer benefit elections for Nora and Caleb Thimblefern after Nora reported the marriage is a qualifying event. Decide whether Caleb should move to Nora’s medical plan or keep separate coverage.
tickets.evidence: Employer benefit elections remain needed by 2025-08-09 because Nora reported the marriage is a qualifying event and the couple has not decided whether Caleb should move to Nora’s medical plan or keep separate coverage.
